provenance.backend: TorchCUDA training; exact four-qubit differentiable simulation; CPU checkpoint replay
provenance.scope: Classical learned sampler with quantum features of the actual reduced-Gibbs Z measurement marginal; not coherent quantum denoising or GRH

conventions.Zmask: bit0 labels leastsignificant basis bit, hence qubit3
conventions.physical_model: Genus2 clean dessin K2,5 quantum matter; trace white spins and retain black0,black1
conventions.parameter_note: Final RZ phases are invisible to the final all-Z readout; nominal parameter budget is not effective capacity
